descriptionChirho: Substantive use referring to a person or persons of a certain kind or quality, translated 'such a one' or 'such people'.
Substantive use referring to things, matters, or abstract realities of a certain kind, translated 'such things' or 'such matters'.
Adjectival or qualifying use describing the nature or quality of something, translated 'such' or 'of this kind' when modifying or characterizing a noun.
